reason_for_new_identity: CSPT001 did not group alternate queries of the same state across splits; its primary metric could be passed by a recipient-only shortcut
scope: Source-controlled synthetic diagnostic; not a real-data or scientifically qualified comparison

method.partition_identity: SHA256(initial_owners,object_identities,receiver,transferred_item) modulo 10; query and view excluded; train buckets 0-7, DEV 8, exploratory TEST 9
method.counterfactual_filter: A different receiver is eligible only if its full state key remains in the same split
method.target_boundary: Predictor observes initial facts, action and query only; EMA target sees post-facts inside loss; evaluator never passes labels or target text to predictor

primary_metric_definition: For one heldout state, both transferred-item and unchanged-item queries must be correct, and one counterfactual receiver query with both states kept inside the same heldout partition must also be correct and different
positive_diagnostic_signal: causal_latent has >=0.05 absolute paired DEV state_triplet_exact gain over answer_only in all three seeds without any DEV unaffected_owner loss greater than 0.03; both have identical scenario hash per seed
negative_diagnostic_signal: Any negative seed or failed integrity gate rejects the positive diagnostic signal; three seeds remain descriptive only
bias_and_limitations: Target state generated by oracle rather than observed
Different auxiliary supervision and per-step compute
Only one event, not persistent state
Answer-only is not full next-token language modeling
